name: ButtonGroup
purpose: Groups related Buttons into an attached/segmented or spaced control cluster for tool toggles and toolbar actions.
scenarios: Exclusive tool toggles such as paint vs erase on a mask canvas
Horizontal toolbar action cluster with shared borders
Vertical stacked action group in a narrow tools pane

variant.description: attached shares borders (segmented); spaced uses a token gap.

size.description: Size hint for nested Buttons (sm/md tokens).

disabled.description: Marks the group disabled for assistive tech; still disable each Button.

antiPatterns: Do not hand-roll segmented borders around loose Buttons — use ButtonGroup variant=attached.
Do not put non-Button interactive controls inside the group.
Selection state stays on each Button (solid vs outline); ButtonGroup is visual grouping only.

a11y.focus: Focus moves among child Buttons; group itself is not focusable.
a11y.labeling: Pass label (aria-label) when there is no visible group legend.

responsive.strategy: Inline-flex cluster; wrap with Stack or switch orientation in narrow panes.

breakpoints.compact: Prefer horizontal attached groups in toolbars; stack vertically if needed.

rtl.strategy: Logical border-radius and margin on attached segments; row follows document direction.
